_readme: [Valentine2023 2026-10-15] Starlight Recital numbers (Base/Valentine2023/Valentine2023Ui.cs re-reads this file on change). OFFICIAL = from the client (luaUiRes_EN[1334], Server_Key tValentinesDayConcert_DelText, DlgLoverDayMain lua). DERIVED = not in the client, balanced choice, change freely.
_spiritInspiration: DERIVED: Performance Inspiration per defeated instrument spirit (4 spirits x 3 = 12 >= the 10 notes of one Recital day).
_spiritDreamNotes: DERIVED: Dream Notes per spirit (the official drop item is not in the client; Dream Note is the event's reward currency).
_spiritPoints: DERIVED: Ardor Points per spirit (official text 'got %s and %s points', amount not in the client).
_spiritMinutes: DERIVED: a summoned spirit leaves after this many minutes if not defeated (it can be challenged again).
_noteDreamNotes: DERIVED count: every lit note gives Dream Notes (official preview 'Reward: Dream Notes, <item>'); the per-note item is OFFICIAL (tRewardItemInfo, hard-coded).
_notePoints: DERIVED: Ardor Points per lit note.
_extra: OFFICIAL: luaUiRes_EN[1334].ExtraTitle 'Reward: 100-500 Ardor Points' when the Magic Book marker stops in the Extra zone.
_power: OFFICIAL: TimeEnergyInfo 'up to 100 points', ShineWarsTip / LackTimeEnergy '50 points of Time Power'.
_powerRegen: DERIVED: start value and the amount recovered every 60 minutes (official text: 'will recover a bit ... every 60 minutes').
_berry: DERIVED: Time Berries (3600449, 1 berry = 1 point, OFFICIAL) usable per day (official text tValentineDay2022Npc[Msg][Limit], number not in the client).
_shootCooldownMs: anti-spam: minimum time between two notes (the client animation takes ~1 s).
